newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yield falls on Bulgaria 12-mth floater T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yield falls on Bulgaria 12-mth floater T-bills.

text.p: Yield fell on Bulgaria's Finance Ministry 12-month floating interest T-bills auctioned on Monday as a cut in the central bank main interest rate went into force, central bank figures showed.
Average yield to maturity on the issue was 49.90 percent, down from 59.30 percent at the respective auction on May 19.
The issue was offered with no minimum acceptable price set in advance.
Interest on the paper is due at maturity. It equals the central bank main interest rate and is adjusted every time the rate is changed.
A cut in the central bank main interest rate to 43.08 percent annually from 51.48 percent became effective on Monday.
